_doc: One n8n per Authentik group: THE ONE PLACE they are declared. Each gets its own namespace, database, secrets, Authentik gate and SCIM provider, and NODES_EXCLUDE = the floor in apps/n8n-sso/src/instances.ts plus `nodesExclude` here. After any change run `pnpm --filter @rmx/n8n-sso build && node apps/n8n-sso/dist/generate-instances.mjs .`, then `infrastructure/hetzner/scripts/seed-secrets.sh dev` and `n8n-sso-bootstrap.sh dev <id>`. Empty until the owner names the groups: an idle instance costs real memory (docs/n8n/01-identity.md measures it). Entry: {"id":"finance","group":"app-n8n-finance","host":"n8n-finance.<apex>","nodesExclude":["n8n-nodes-base.httpRequest"]}.
